title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
content: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
content: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
content: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.

title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
content: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.

title: Bitcoin weakness erases September's bullish signal
content: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 12, 2026

title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge 13%
content: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
content: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
content: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
content: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
content: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, With CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
content: The Nvidia co-founder steps down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, ending his 33-year run.

title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
content: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

title: DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
content: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.

title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Venues Are Launching Without Big Tech’s Approval
content: Plus, a second Jensen Huang affair is rocking markets while MSCI’s MSTR removal decision sends crypto lower.

title: India's Financial Crimes Agency Searches CoinDCX, Delta Exchange Over Offshore Trades
content: The Enforcement Directorate alleges the exchanges routed Indian users' trades to Binance, Bybit and others via a Costa Rican shell entity.

title: BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears
content: Bitcoin Magazine BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears A Nov. 5 13F shows Bank of New York Mellon held 237,100 Strive shares worth $6.97 million at Sept. 30, up 51,544 shares from June, with other large filers still due Monday. This post BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Rumble (RUM) Sells Two-Thirds of Its Bitcoin as AI Cloud Business Delivers First Profitable Quarter
content: Bitcoin Magazine Rumble (RUM) Sells Two-Thirds of Its Bitcoin as AI Cloud Business Delivers First Profitable Quarter RUM Group held 94.68 bitcoin worth $7.9 million on Sept. 30, down from 293.14 at the end of June, as its Quake AI unit drove record revenue of $96.6 million. This post Rumble (RUM) Sells Two-Thirds of Its Bitcoin as AI Cloud Business Delivers First Profitable Quarter first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows
content: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $299.8 million on Wednesday, their fifth straight day of outflows, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $269.7 million and about 94% of November's withdrawals. This post BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides Bitcoin price fell below $72,000 on Thursday, its lowest level since mid-August, after Nvidia said CEO Jensen Huang had resigned and Strategy shares slid on MSCI's confirmed index exit. This post Bitcoin Price Falls Below $72,000 as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Steps Down and Strategy (MSTR) Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
content: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close, after a new screen classified them as non-operating companies. This post MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
